2-1/4 Inch Offset New York Shutter Hinges

text.description_html:
Acorn AK2BI, Black Iron New York Shutter 2-1/4 Inch Offset Hinge

Acorn's New York Shutter Hinges have a loose joint construction that allows shutters to be easily hung or removed. The 2-1/4 Inch Offset New York Shutter Hinge measures 4-1/4 inches vertical and 5 inches wide. Sold as set of 2 pairs, one pair for each side of the window. Comes with stainless steel screws. The Acorn AK2BI 2-1/4 inch offset hinge is for brick construction. The matte black finish is perfect for adding an old world feel to your shutters.

Features and Specifications of the New York Shutter Hinge:

  • Finish: Matte Black
  • Hinge Leaf Length: 4-1/4"
  • Hinge Leaf Width: 5"
  • Pintle Plate Length: 3-1/8"
  • Pintle Plate Width: 1-1/8"
  • Offset: 2-1/4"
  • Reveal: 4-1/2"
  • For Brick Construction
  • Packaged Includes: 2 pairs (4 hinges) and stainless steel screws.
  • Lifetime No Rust Warranty

Priced and sold as 2 pairs (4 hinges, one set for each shutter).
